title: With no signal, My membership shows the days left and visits as they were on the day it was saved
what: When the gym cannot be reached, the card shows the plan kept on the phone. Its 'days left', 'Ends today' and 'days at the gym this month' are worked out from the day the answer was saved, not from today. A member offline at the desk 5 days later still sees '12 days left'; a plan that ended since still shows as running; last month's visits show in a new month. Only a small grey line says it is from an earlier day.
expected: Days left and ended-or-not are worked out from today's date, and the month's visits are hidden when the kept answer is from another month.
how_often: each time the Gym tab opens with no signal on a later day
fix_line: Work out days left from today's date when showing a kept answer, and drop the visits line from another month

title: The gym leaderboard and the trainer's chart count 'kg lifted' differently for the same workouts
what: The kg a member sends to the gym leaderboard counts part of their body weight on pull-ups, dips and other body-weight moves, and doubles for paired dumbbells, by the app's own volume rule. The weekly kg sent to the trainer counts only the weight on the bar or in the hands, on purpose so body weight cannot be worked back. So the same week shows one kg total on the leaderboard and another on the trainer's chart, and the leaderboard number carries the body weight the trainer share was built to keep out.
expected: One 'kg lifted' rule for everything the gym sees, the same number on the leaderboard and the trainer chart, without the member's body weight in it.
how_often: every member who does body-weight or dumbbell moves and shares both
fix_line: Send the leaderboard the same bar-weight-only kg the trainer share uses
